notes.title: Exploration mode
notes.content:
[h2]Introducing the new [b]Exploration [/b]mode![/h2]

An [b]easier[/b] game mode in which you [b]don't lose your progression[/b] when you die and [b]respawn [/b]at the [b]last activated altar[/b].

[b]Available now![/b]
